# AgiBot AimDK Python protocol wheel

`a3_aimdk-3.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` is copied from the official AgiBot A3 Ultra
AimDK v3.2 development package (`prebuilt/`). It is installed into the driver
image at build time so battery, emergency-stop, and command protobuf schemas do
not depend on a development-kit mount being present at runtime.

SHA-256: `2ce4ede82a5e82f4724414c0cb82f9966538b7232eef6cf70c96c1b6dd55edb4`

The upstream wheel metadata does not declare a distribution license. Keep this
artifact limited to the official package contents and retain this provenance
notice; confirm redistribution terms with AgiBot before publishing this
repository outside its authorized audience.
